description: A warm, friendly woman in her thirties or forties with a clear, natural, mid-pitched voice, a native German speaker with a standard High German accent. She says a short prayer aloud the way people say it together in church every day: fluent and flowing, at a normal conversational speed, warm and sincere, without dragging and without dramatic pauses.
ref_text: Ehre sei dem Vater und dem Sohn und dem Heiligen Geist, wie im Anfang, so auch jetzt und alle Zeit und in Ewigkeit. Amen.
